title: Mitra Megah Interior — 3D Spatial CAD & Material Configurator
description: An interactive 3D Web CAD and spatial interior configurator engineered for Mitra Megah Bangunan, featuring real-time PBR material rendering, native SketchUp model integration, and automated architectural report generation.
longDescription:
Mitra Megah Interior 3D CAD & Spatial Configurator is an architectural visualization and interactive spatial engineering platform developed for Mitra Megah Bangunan (Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mitramegahbangunan/ ). The live web platform is deployed and accessible at https://www.mitramegah.online .

The platform bridges architectural drafting and interactive spatial visualization, enabling clients, architects, and interior designers to interactively customize materials, explore lighting atmospheres, and configure custom architectural elements in photorealistic 3D directly from any modern web browser without requiring heavy desktop CAD software installations.

Key architectural and engineering modules include:
• Real-Time 3D Spatial Engine: Built with Three.js, React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber), and @react-three/drei, delivering hardware-accelerated Physically Based Rendering (PBR) with dynamic shadows, ambient daylight models, and cinematic depth of field.
• Native CAD & SketchUp (.SKP) Pipeline: Features an automated converter pipeline that ingests SketchUp (.skp) binary files, GLTF, and GLB assets via custom OpenSKP parsers, decomposing multi-zone architectural meshes into modular customizable sub-surfaces.
• Material Laboratory & Procedural Specifier: An interactive materials studio supporting real-time swaps of Italian Statuario Carrara marble, Nordic white oak parquet, honed Roman travertine, Shou Sugi Ban charred cedar, custom terrazzo, and auto-trimmed ceramic floor tiling with dynamic grout generators.
• Architectural Camera & Presentation Mode: Intuitive multi-perspective camera presets including Isometric, Top-Down 2D Floor Plan, Architectural Elevations, and First-Person Interior Walkthrough modes tailored for executive client presentations.
• Automated Specification Sheets & PDF Reporting: An integrated jsPDF export engine that calculates surface square meterage, generates itemized Bills of Materials (BOM), produces detailed material spec sheets, and outputs formal client proposals.
• Cloud CDN & Enterprise Multi-User Workspace: Powered by Next.js App Router, Docker containerization, Bunny.net global edge storage for high-poly 3D models, and a robust role-based access control (RBAC) workspace system.

title: Meridian — Contemporary Clothing Store & 3D Garment Marketplace
description: A contemporary fashion e-commerce platform built with Next.js 16 and Three.js, enabling shoppers to inspect studio photography or interactively orbit any garment in 360° 3D before choosing their size.
longDescription:
Meridian is a modern contemporary clothing storefront and interactive 3D garment marketplace engineered to bridge luxury editorial photography with real-time WebGL product inspection. Shoppers can browse heavyweight cotton tees, knitwear, washed denim, and outerwear while seamlessly switching between studio photos and a full 360° interactive 3D garment viewer.

Key engineering and architecture modules include:
• Interactive 3D Garment Viewer (Three.js): Powered by a custom GLB model loader and dynamic front/back garment texture builder, letting customers drag and rotate every piece in real time to inspect drape, silhouette, collar weight, and front/back graphics before picking a size.
• Full-Stack Storefront & Seller Studio: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, featuring instant category filtering, live shopping bag and wishlist drawers, member authentication with automatic member discounts, promo vouchers, order tracking, and a dedicated Seller Studio plus Admin Console.
• Cloudflare D1 & R2 Edge Architecture: Uses a structured D1 relational database for products, orders, vouchers, and sessions while offloading high-resolution garment packshots and 3D .glb model binaries to S3-compatible Cloudflare R2 object storage.
• BinderPay SNAP BI Checkout: Integrated Indonesian multi-channel payment gateway supporting QRIS with live QR rendering, Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Permata, BSI, CIMB), and Payment Links with RSA signature verification.

title: VNYL Store — Vinyl Pressings & Limited Editions E-Commerce
description: An editorial vinyl record storefront built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Radix UI featuring curated seasonal pressings, limited archival drops, live catalog filtering, an interactive Admin Studio, and IDR QRIS/VA checkout.
longDescription:
VNYL Store is an editorial vinyl record e-commerce platform and curation suite designed for collectors of heavyweight 180g pressings, colored limited variants, pre-order releases, and archival LPs priced in IDR.

Key engineering and product highlights include:
• Editorial Storefront & Discovery Experience: Crafted with Syne display typography, IBM Plex Mono pressing metadata, and Plus Jakarta Sans UI copy. Features a full-bleed hero carousel, artist discovery strip, pinned featured releases, a Hyped Vinyl limited-run spotlight with peeking disc previews, and a genre directory.
• Catalog Browser & Pressing Detail Pages: Responsive multi-filter shop interface supporting collection filters, real-time title/artist/catalog-number search, detailed vinyl pressing sheets (format, wax colorway, condition, imprint), slide-over cart sheet, and wishlist persistence.
• Full Admin Studio & Live Preview: Protected management console featuring a Banner Manager, Pin Curation Panel for landing page sections, Product and Promo Managers, Bulk Data import/export tools, Order tracking panel, Payment Settings, and a live Admin Preview Studio.
• BinderPay SNAP API Integration: End-to-end payment checkout supporting QRIS QR generation, Virtual Accounts, and Payment Links with dedicated order payment tracking views and encrypted credential management.

title: ClimatiX — Climate Tech & Carbon Credit Ecosystem
description: An end-to-end climate technology ecosystem connecting IoT sensors, AI-powered carbon analytics, and blockchain tokenization to bring transparency to the carbon market.
longDescription:
ClimatiX is an end-to-end climate technology ecosystem designed to improve transparency, trust, and accessibility within the carbon credit market through the integration of modern digital technologies. It addresses the systemic issues in the voluntary carbon market—such as greenwashing, double counting, and opaque verification processes—by replacing manual, periodic audits with continuous, machine-certified environmental data.

The ecosystem consists of three integrated platforms: ClimatiX Devices (an IoT-based environmental monitoring system capturing temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and gas concentrations in conservation areas), ClimatiX LandHub (an intelligent monitoring dashboard providing real-time visualization, AI-powered carbon estimation, and project management insights), and ClimatiX GreenTrade (a blockchain-powered marketplace where verified carbon credits are tokenized using ERC-1155 smart contracts to ensure transparent ownership, digital trading, and secure transactions).

Built on a modern technology stack, ClimatiX combines low-power LoRaWAN networks, MQTT telemetry protocols, Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Pub/Sub and Vertex AI), Firebase Firestore, and public smart contracts. Together, these technologies establish a secure, scalable data-to-token pipeline that supports ESG compliance and accelerates the transition to a global Net-Zero carbon economy.

title: VORCE — Enterprise Workforce & HR Management Platform
description: An enterprise-grade hybrid HR platform combining GPS/Face ID attendance, real-time leaves, OCR-powered reimbursements, tasks, and performance tracking.
longDescription:
VORCE HR Management is an enterprise-grade hybrid workforce management and human resource ecosystem designed to streamline business operations and synchronize employee activities. Built to scale, the system marks a transition from a legacy REST API architecture to a high-performance Hybrid (REST API + Firebase Firestore) model.

Under this hybrid schema, all transactional writes and complex business validations—such as check-ins, check-outs, leave applications, and reimbursement workflows—are processed securely through REST API controllers. This ensures the backend remains the absolute source of truth. Simultaneously, the platform utilizes real-time Firestore listeners to instantly stream updates back to the web dashboard and mobile app, bypassing polling and GET APIs to provide an instantaneous user experience.

The platform integrates several specialized modules:
• Presence & Shift Management: GPS geocoding coordinates, Face ID logins, and shift schedules synced via Firestore.
• Leave & Time-Off Requests: A decentralized CRUD system where files (such as medical certificates) are uploaded, and leave data is synchronized using strict ISO8601 timestamps.
• OCR-Powered Reimbursements: Integrates a Cloud Run extraction endpoint to scan receipts via OCR, automatically parsing metadata and posting real-time reimbursement claims with Firebase Web SDK.
• Task & Collaboration: Supports multi-assignee task distribution, sub-task attachments, and real-time status changes handled directly through Firestore documents.
• Personal AI Assistant (Mitsu AI): User-scoped chat histories, markdown-formatted prompt responses, and a secure transaction-safe system to transfer credit tokens between employee profile documents.

title: SMS-Vest — Smart Marine Safety Vest Ecosystem
description: An IoT-based smart safety vest and coastal base station ecosystem utilizing LoRa telemetry and AI diagnosis for traditional fishermen.
longDescription:
SMS-Vest (Smart Marine Safety Vest) is an innovative, low-cost safety ecosystem designed to protect traditional fishermen operating in GSM cellular dead zones. The project addresses the critical issue of maritime accidents and rescue delays by integrating wearable IoT technology with long-range radio networks and artificial intelligence.

The wearable vest is equipped with an ESP32 microcontroller, GPS u-blox NEO-M8N, MPU6050 accelerometer/gyroscope for fall and immobility detection, MAX30102 for heart rate and SpO₂ monitoring, DS18B20 for body/water temperature monitoring, and a water-immersion sensor. Telemetry data is transmitted via LoRa SX1262 (920 MHz) over distances of up to 25 km to a coastal gateway base station, bypassing the need for cellular networks. An AI-powered assistant (integrating the OpenAI API) processes the real-time physiological and environmental data on the base station server, identifying hypothermia risks, extreme fatigue, and emergency situations, immediately triggering automated rescue alerts with precise GPS coordinates for search and rescue operations.

title: VORCE — Workforce Intelligence & Operations Platform
description: An end-to-end workforce intelligence and business operations platform combining employee directories, attendance tracking, task management, and desktop device analytics.
longDescription:
VORCE is an integrated, end-to-end workforce intelligence and business operations platform designed to help organizations streamline employee management, monitor work activities, and extract real-time operational insights. I developed the platform end-to-end, starting from the responsive Next.js landing page to building the comprehensive web dashboard, and integrating the complete mobile and desktop telemetry systems.

At its core, VORCE unites GPS/Face ID attendance tracking, shift scheduling, task coordination, OCR receipt reimbursement, and organizational knowledge databases into a single responsive portal. By integrating device telemetry from the VLinked desktop agent, the platform's intelligence engine aggregates raw system activity into higher-level workforce signals. This generates real-time analytics for focus ratios, productivity scores, workload levels, and behavioral trends, presenting an executive view of team performance while maintaining data privacy and security.

title: VLinked — Desktop Monitoring Agent
description: Electron-powered cross-platform desktop telemetry agent capturing device and active-window analytics for VORCE.
longDescription:
VLinked Desktop Agent is a lightweight, cross-platform desktop monitoring agent developed as part of the VORCE ecosystem. It runs silently on macOS, Windows, and Linux machines to collect essential telemetry metrics, enabling companies to track employee device health, app-specific usage, and active work times.

As the Lead Desktop Developer, I built the agent using Electron, ensuring high-efficiency monitoring without high system overhead. Key implementations included secure OAuth token persistence via the OS keychain (DPAPI/safeStorage), background tracking systems using systeminformation and powerMonitor for idle-time checking, and a sandboxed IPC renderer architecture. All metric updates stream directly to the centralized VORCE API, serving as the single point of entry to ensure absolute data consistency and system security.

title: Smart Fleet Management (Velinked)
description: Comprehensive vehicle fleet management and driver behavior tracking platform leveraging IoT hardware (VeMonitor & VeControl), web analytics, and mobile workflows.
longDescription:
Velinked is an end-to-end fleet management ecosystem engineered to unify vehicle tracking, remote engine control, and driver safety analytics using custom IoT hardware and real-time cloud dashboards.

Developed as our Gold Medal-winning innovation at FIKSI 2024 (Festival Inovasi dan Kewirausahaan Siswa Indonesia), the system pairs two custom hardware units—VeMonitor for continuous GPS, speed, and engine telemetry, and VeControl for authorized remote engine immobilization—with a dual-platform software suite.

On the software layer, fleet managers access a centralized web console displaying live vehicle locations, trip histories, automated driver behavior safety scores, operational expense tracking, and employee attendance management. Drivers use a companion mobile interface to submit expenses, request leave, and monitor vehicle status updates in real time. As Team Leader & IoT Engineer, I led the hardware-to-cloud telemetry pipeline, driver behavior scoring logic, and system architecture.

title: Driver Behavior & Telemetry Dashboard
description: Interactive web and mobile interface for fleet vehicle operators displaying driving safety scores, trip analytics, speed diagnostics, and operational workflows.
longDescription:
The Driver Behavior & Telemetry Dashboard is a specialized companion interface within the fleet management ecosystem designed to give vehicle operators transparent feedback on road safety and daily trip operations.

Built to translate high-frequency IoT telemetry events from on-board vehicle sensors into clear visual indicators, the dashboard surfaces trip logs, speed profiles, and instant safety alerts for harsh braking, rapid acceleration, and aggressive cornering events. Beyond telemetry analytics, the portal streamlines day-to-day operational tasks for drivers, including one-tap expense reimbursement uploads, shift readiness checks, and online leave submissions synchronized directly with the fleet operator's management console.

title: DermDoc — Skin Scan & Consult App
description: AI-powered dermatological screening and consultation application utilizing deep learning classification models to evaluate skin lesions and connect patients with specialists.
longDescription:
DermDoc is a health-technology application built to make preliminary dermatological screening and specialist consultation accessible via mobile devices. Its core diagnostic pipeline integrates three deep learning image classification models trained on dermatological datasets to assist users in evaluating suspicious skin conditions.

The scanner analyzes user-captured skin imagery to screen across critical categories including Melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, multiple common carcinoma/lesion classes, and allergic dermatological reactions. Beyond automated computer vision inference, the application connects screening results with a structured medication reference database and a doctor appointment booking workflow.

As Team Leader and Machine Learning Lead, I architected the end-to-end product workflow, coordinated computer vision model evaluation and API integration, and led mobile interface engineering to ensure fast image upload, clear risk-guidance presentation, and seamless transition from scan to clinical consultation.

title: Smart Home Dashboard
description: A comprehensive IoT web dashboard for real-time monitoring, scheduling, and low-latency remote control of smart home automation hardware.
longDescription:
The Smart Home Dashboard is an integrated IoT web portal built to unify residential environmental monitoring, appliance automation, and status alerts inside a responsive real-time interface.

Designed around bidirectional synchronization between microcontroller nodes and a cloud real-time database, the platform allows homeowners to monitor room sensors, toggle relays and connected fixtures remotely, configure automated schedules, and receive immediate device state alerts. I engineered both the frontend control interface and the supporting backend API endpoints, focusing on responsive command latency, clean visual state feedback, and reliable synchronization between edge IoT hardware and web clients.

title: Smart Vehicle App
description: Connected vehicle mobile and embedded telemetry system integrating C hardware firmware, Python cloud pipelines, and real-time remote vehicle monitoring.
longDescription:
The Smart Vehicle App is an early connected-mobility platform designed to stream live vehicle diagnostics, GPS coordinates, and lock status between embedded hardware and a mobile companion interface.

Using low-level C firmware on the in-vehicle microcontroller interfacing with hardware sensors, the system samples telemetry packets and relays them through a Python-based telemetry ingestion pipeline to the cloud. Drivers can inspect real-time vehicle health indices, track parking/transit locations, and trigger remote locking controls directly from their mobile device. This project laid the embedded C firmware and hardware-to-cloud integration foundation that later inspired more advanced automotive and marine IoT ecosystems.
